# Maskan Builders LLP

Maskan Builders is the premier construction company in Kerala, India. We specialize in residential construction, commercial construction, architectural & interior design, landscape, renovation, and turnkey projects.

With over 17 years of experience and 750+ projects completed, we provide comprehensive end-to-end solutions, from site surveys and approvals to execution and final handover. Our commitment is to structural durability, engineering precision, and timeless architecture.
